summary_md: **NVIDIA AI ([@NVIDIAAI](https://x.com/NVIDIAAI/status/2115462300241141882))** launches **Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe**, an open-weight promptable 30B MoE (~4B active) combining transcription in 40 languages, speaker attribution, translation, contextual prompting and audio understanding in one checkpoint. The self-thread says it ranks #1 among open-weight models on the Hugging Face Open ASR English leaderboard (5.33% avg WER), links the weights, a demo Space and a Granary v2 fine-tuning blog, and notes vLLM and SGLang support.
